_about: Official Discord servers ProveIt can check. Only servers listed here can be verified, so a copycat server can never be used. Each role ID maps to one label: Admin or Mod. Role IDs come from the server's admins (Discord Developer Mode → Server Settings → Roles → right-click a role → Copy Role ID). Changing guildId, name or roles changes the Discord action's CID and signer; officialSource is only shown on the website. Leave officialSource empty only for private test servers.
